questions.text: Which milestone in 1969 laid the foundation for the modern Internet by connecting four U.S. universities under DARPA funding?
choices: The establishment of the ARPANET experimental computer network
The public adoption of TCP/IP as a standard networking protocol
The invention of the World Wide Web by scientist Tim Berners-Lee
The commercial deployment of high-speed fiber-optic broadband

questions.text: What fundamental advantage does a global network of interconnected devices provide over isolated standalone systems?
choices: It eliminates the physical hardware requirement for data storage
It enables distributed resource sharing and standardized data exchange
It guarantees zero latency and immune security against data interception
It allows single-core processors to execute tasks without operating systems

questions.text: In modern network architecture, what is the primary role of a router when handling incoming data streams?
choices: Permanently archiving raw data frames inside internal system memory
Analyzing destination IP addresses to forward packets across networks
Translating high-level source code into binary machine instructions
Modulating electrical signal frequencies across local analog copper wire

questions.text: How does packet switching optimize network transmission compared to traditional circuit switching?
choices: By establishing a dedicated, unbroken physical path prior to sending data
By dividing data into independent packets routed dynamically over shared links
By transmitting entire unsegmented files in a single uninterrupted burst
By converting digital signals into analog acoustic waves across node switches

questions.text: Which application layer protocol operates over TCP port 80/443 to facilitate hypertext document transfer across web clients?
choices: HTTP / HTTPS protocol suites for web content retrieval
FTP / SFTP protocol suites for remote file management
SMTP / IMAP protocol suites for electronic mail transfer
DNS / DHCP protocol suites for network IP assignment

questions.text: What distinguishes a Layer 2 network switch from a Layer 3 network router during data delivery?
choices: Switches route data globally using IP, while routers handle local MAC addresses
Switches forward frames using MAC addresses within a local LAN segment
Switches convert binary packets into optical pulses for long-haul backbones
Switches encrypt data payloads, while routers decrypt incoming header fields

questions.text: What is the primary conceptual purpose of the 7-Layer Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) reference model?
choices: Standardizing network functions into distinct modular layers for interoperability
Compiling client-side web application scripts into assembly instructions
Enforcing hardware encryption standards on consumer router motherboard chips
Allocating physical storage sectors across network-attached hard drive arrays

questions.text: Which technical condition is most directly responsible for triggering packet loss in high-traffic routing nodes?
choices: Excessive router buffer overflow caused by severe network traffic congestion
Incompatible screen resolution settings between local sender and receiver
High battery charge levels causing thermal throttling on client devices
Automated DNS domain record refreshes during active TCP transmission

questions.text: What occurs at the transport layer when network congestion degrades packet delivery performance?
choices: TCP congestion control reduces transmission window size and triggers retransmissions
The network router automatically deletes all client user accounts from the database
The underlying physical fiber cables shut down to prevent electrical overheating
Web browser applications force a hard system reboot to clear network cache
